# Typography

11 rules in this category.

## typography-E2B6ED29

**SHOULD:** Choose fonts that are readable rather than decorative.

*Readable type supports scanning the many text sizes present in infographics.*

Movements: `minimalism`

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## typography-8A2F19B2

**SHOULD:** Select fonts that scale well across infographic text sizes.

*Infographics require distinct sizes for titles, headings, stats, and captions.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## typography-5A4A7D56

**SHOULD_NOT:** Avoid script fonts and overly complex serif fonts in infographics.

*Decorative typefaces distract from the many visual information points viewers scan.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

## typography-5533A980

**SHOULD:** Prefer sans-serif type set flush left with a ragged right edge.

*Sans-serif flush-left setting was the typographic standard of Swiss style posters.*

- https://vanseodesign.com/web-design/swiss-design/
